feature: CRUD tabel ocms_vip_vehicle di staff API (/vipvehicle), tanpa layar UI
note: BaseController CRUD untuk tabel ocms_vip_vehicle di ocmsadminapi (RequestMapping /vipvehicle). Tidak ada layar di ocmsadminui yang memakainya dan tidak ada entri di api-authorization.properties, jadi tidak jelas siapa yang boleh memanggil; ocms_vip_vehicle diisi oleh job CAS di ocmsadminprivateapi (tiket OCMS-SR-2026-051 menunjukkan koreksi manual lewat DB script). Pemeliharaan manual daftar tidak punya story sendiri; bukan bagian OCMS14.17 yang meminta penerimaan dari FOMS.
note_en: BaseController CRUD for table ocms_vip_vehicle in ocmsadminapi (RequestMapping /vipvehicle). No ocmsadminui screen uses it and there is no entry in api-authorization.properties, so it is unclear who may call it; ocms_vip_vehicle is filled by the CAS job in ocmsadminprivateapi (ticket OCMS-SR-2026-051 shows manual correction through a DB script). Manual maintenance of the list has no story of its own; it is not part of OCMS14.17, which asks for receiving from FOMS.

note: Method triggerClvSuspension memanggil temporarySuspensionHelper.processTS untuk kode CLV, tetapi grep di ocmsadminapi tidak menemukan pemanggilnya; satu-satunya referensi class ini adalah field di CreateNoticeServiceImpl. Penangguhan CLV yang benar-benar jalan ada di ocmsadminprivateapi (AutoRevivalHelper dan ToppanUploadHelper). Kemungkinan sisa kode.
note_en: Method triggerClvSuspension calls temporarySuspensionHelper.processTS for code CLV, but grep in ocmsadminapi finds no caller; the only reference to this class is a field in CreateNoticeServiceImpl. The CLV suspension that actually runs is in ocmsadminprivateapi (AutoRevivalHelper and ToppanUploadHelper). Likely leftover code.
